subject: OptiHealth evaluation kickoff — proposed dates & prep
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Jordan <sam.jordan@optihealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: OptiHealth evaluation kickoff — proposed dates & prep

Thanks again for taking the time today, Sam — great conversation. Quick recap + next steps so we can lock the evaluation kickoff: 

Recap (from today's discovery)
- Goal: run a 4-week evaluation to measure retrieval-augmented generation for summarization & triage in OptiHealth's provider portal.
- Success criteria you called out: latency < 350ms p95 for common flows, >85% precision on redaction-sensitive prompts, and no PHI exfiltration.
- Must-haves: SSO + audit logs, optional on-prem testing for the redaction workflows.

Proposed kickoff windows (pick one):
- Tue Aug 3, 10:00–11:00 PT (team review + high-level trial plan)
- Thu Aug 5, 14:00–15:00 PT (includes technical deep-dive with infra)

What we'll cover in kickoff:
- 20m: trial plan & success criteria alignment (I've attached the v1 trial plan)
- 30m: technical deep-dive (networking, data flows, VPN access if needed, initial prompt set)
- 10m: roles & timeline / calendar sync

Prep needed from OptiHealth for the deep-dive:
- A short sample prompt set (10–20 examples) or the Drive link to existing examples
- Name and contact for the infra lead who can discuss VPN/firewall rules
- Confirmation if you want us to include an on-prem agent for redaction tests

I've attached the trial plan and a calendar stub (ICS). If Thu Aug 5 at 14:00 PT works, please confirm and I'll send invites to the team.

Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Sales Director
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: optihealth-trial-plan-v1.pdf, redwood-kickoff-agenda.ics

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the recap. Thu Aug 5 at 14:00 PT works best for us. Looping in Elena (PM) and Michael (CTO) — they'll join the deep-dive.

A couple quick items from our side:
- Elena will drop a link to our sample prompts; we have a 12-example set targeted at triage and summary.
- Michael requests a short checklist for network requirements (VPN, IP allowlist, ports). Can your infra team supply that before the call?
- One more question: for the initial tests, do you recommend we use hosted Redwood endpoints or try the private (VPC) preview? We want to replicate on-prem redaction behavior if possible.

Sam
